steps.message: What events do I have Tuesday in Simple Calendar Pro? Answer with the titles only. If there are multiple titles, format your answer as a comma separated list.
Execute: adb shell "date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z %z'; pm list packages | grep -i simple"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z %z'; pm list packages | grep -i simple""

steps.message: Execute: adb shell "for u in content://com.simplemobiletools.calendar.pro.events/events content://com.simplemobiletools.calendar.pro.provider/events content://com.simplemobiletools.calendar.pro/events content://com.simplemobiletools.calendar/events content://com.simplemobiletools.calendar.pro.provider/calendarevents; do echo '=== '$u' ==='; content query --uri $u --limit 1 2>&1; done"
